listings.name: Ieglaasi Nieyah Primary School
listings.address: 6 Kyalami Street, Beacon Valley, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town, 7785
listings.current_description: Ieglaasi Nieyah Primary School is an independent Islamic school at 6 Kyalami Street in Beacon Valley, Mitchells Plain, offering both primary and high school phases and opened in 1995 as the area's first independent Islamic primary school.

listings.name: Intellisec
listings.address: 19 Prosperity Park, Computer Road, Montague Gardens, Cape Town, 7441
listings.current_description: Intellisec is a turnkey supplier of intelligent site management systems -- including CCTV, access control, fire detection and electric fencing -- installed and maintained by its own certified technicians, with a Cape Town office in Montague Gardens.

listings.name: Kingdom Kidz Educare Academy
listings.address: 6 Topsham Road, Ottery East, Cape Town, 7800
listings.current_description: Kingdom Kidz Educare Academy is a daycare and crèche in Ottery East offering an English-medium early learning programme for babies from 3 months through preschoolers up to age 5, spanning crèche, toddler and preschool stages.

listings.name: Knead Dean Street
listings.address: Shop 7, Dean Street Arcade, Dean St, Newlands, Cape Town, 7700
listings.current_description: Knead Dean Street is an artisan bakery cafe in Dean Street Arcade, Newlands, serving oven-fresh bread, pastries, pizza, salads and burgers alongside its own roasted coffee; it was the first halaal-certified branch of the Knead Bakery chain.

listings.name: Kukoma Coffee Co.
listings.address: 136 St George's Street, Simon's Town, Cape Town, 7995
listings.current_description: Kukoma Coffee Co. is a specialty coffee roastery and cafe in Simon's Town sourcing and roasting ethically traded Arabica beans from Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi and Ethiopia, with an on-site barista bar, fast Wi-Fi and home-brewing workshops.

listings.name: Lello's Trattoria
listings.address: 7 Penarth Road, Three Anchor Bay, Cape Town, 8005
listings.current_description: Lello's Trattoria is a family-run Roman-style trattoria and deli in Three Anchor Bay serving 72-hour fermented pizza al taglio by the slice, handmade pasta, and artisanal deli produce, with an aperitivo-style evening offering from Thursday to Saturday.

listings.name: Lime Tree Café
listings.address: Sherwood Centre, Corner Children's Way and Dreyersdal Road, Bergvliet, Cape Town, 7945
listings.current_description: Lime Tree Café is a restaurant and deli in Bergvliet's Sherwood Centre that has served the surrounding area for over 11 years, with a menu spanning breakfast items like croissants and tartines through to lunch and dinner.

listings.name: Massimo's
listings.address: Oakhurst Farm Park, Main Road, Hout Bay, Cape Town, 7806
listings.current_description: Massimo's is a family-run Italian restaurant at Oakhurst Farm Park in Hout Bay, known for thin-based wood-fired pizzas and a menu with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options, and named Best Pizzeria in Africa in 2019 and 2021.

listings.name: Nude Foods
listings.address: 5 Constitution Street, Zonnebloem, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Nude Foods is a zero-waste grocery store selling food, home and body products by weight to avoid packaging, and includes an on-site cafe serving coffee, teas and plant-based drinks. It was Cape Town's first plastic-free grocery store.

listings.name: Peacock Tea and Coffee
listings.address: Shop G11, Howard Centre, Corner Howard & Forest Drive, Pinelands, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Peacock Tea and Coffee is a specialist tea and coffee retailer in Howard Centre, Pinelands, sourcing fine teas and gourmet coffee beans from around the world alongside brewing equipment, accessories and crockery, and grinding beans to order.

listings.name: Plant
listings.address: 87 Victoria Road, The Promenade, Camps Bay, Cape Town, 8005
listings.current_description: Plant is an entirely vegan cafe inside The Promenade on Victoria Road in Camps Bay, serving breakfast through dinner with dishes from nachos and hand-crafted burgers to Asian tapas, including a vegan bobotie and seitan bao buns.

listings.name: Radebe's Bed and Breakfast
listings.address: 23 PW Mama Way, Settlers Place, Langa, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Radebe's Bed and Breakfast is a family-run guesthouse in Settlers Place, Langa, open since 2005, with three themed guest bedrooms and a coffee shack serving continental or African breakfasts, with lunch and dinner also available on request.

listings.name: Sentinel Primary School
listings.address: 6 Atlantic Skipper Road, Hangberg, Hout Bay, Cape Town, 7806
listings.current_description: Sentinel Primary School is a public school in Hangberg, Hout Bay, established in 1969 as one of the oldest seaside schools in the Western Cape and later expanded into an intermediate school covering Grades 8 and 9.

listings.name: Specsavers Golden Acre
listings.address: Shop S50, Golden Acre, Cnr Strand & Adderley St, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Specsavers is an optometry retailer offering eye examinations and screening for conditions such as glaucoma and cataracts alongside eyewear and hearing services at selected stores; this branch trades from Shop S50 in Golden Acre, Cape Town CBD.

listings.name: TAH The Animal Hospital and Vetshop Table View
listings.address: 67 Blaauwberg Road, Table View, Cape Town, 7441
listings.current_description: TAH The Animal Hospital and Vetshop in Table View is a full-service veterinary practice with an on-site theatre and a retail vetshop stocking pet food, treats and toys, offering wellness check-ups, vaccinations, dental care and emergency treatment.

listings.name: The Bungalow
listings.address: The Glen Country Club, 3 Victoria Road, Clifton, Cape Town, 8005
listings.current_description: The Bungalow is an oceanfront restaurant at The Glen Country Club in Clifton, serving a menu of fresh sushi, seafood, steak and South African fare with views of the Atlantic between Lion's Head and the Twelve Apostles.

listings.name: The Eatery at Antrim House
listings.address: 23 Antrim Road, Three Anchor Bay, Cape Town
listings.current_description: The Eatery at Antrim House is a bistro-style restaurant in Three Anchor Bay offering an eclectic menu of risotto, catch of the day, pork belly and rack of lamb, with vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options, open daily.

listings.name: The Pole Yard
listings.address: 39 Paarden Eiland Road, Paarden Eiland, Cape Town
listings.current_description: The Pole Yard in Paarden Eiland is a timber and pole supplier specialising in outdoor timber products such as fencing, wooden decking, rustic garden furniture and jungle gyms, alongside a range of pine, cylindrical and eucalyptus poles.

listings.name: Tonic Design
listings.address: 87 Kloof Street, Gardens, 8001
listings.current_description: Tonic Design is a furniture and interior design showroom on Kloof Street in Gardens, known for sofas, cabinetry and other interior pieces, with room sets that include artwork from a collaboration with a Cape Town art gallery.

listings.name: Unimedics International
listings.address: 167 Kromboom Road, Crawford, Cape Town, 7780
listings.current_description: Unimedics International is a multi-disciplinary medical and dental practice in Crawford, part of a group founded in 2015 that also operates branches in Parow and Mitchells Plain, combining general healthcare and dental services with community outreach initiatives.

listings.name: Utopia Dining Elevated
listings.address: 40 Chiappini Street, 15th Floor, Mirage Building, De Waterkant, Cape Town, 8001
listings.current_description: Utopia Dining Elevated is a rooftop fine-dining restaurant 15 floors up in the Mirage Building on Chiappini Street, De Waterkant, serving breakfast, lunch and dinner with panoramic 360-degree views over the Cape Town city bowl and harbour.

listings.name: Antonio's Pizza Place
listings.address: The Boardwalk, Breakwater Lane, Harbour Island, Gordon's Bay, 7140
listings.current_description: Antonio's Pizza Place is a pizza and grill restaurant in the Boardwalk building at Harbour Island, serving pizzas, pastas, seafood, burgers, poultry, steaks, schnitzel and eisbein, with vegetarian and gluten-free options and outdoor deck seating overlooking the harbour.

listings.name: Artformes
listings.address: 373-375 Albert Road, Woodstock, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Artformes is a contemporary African sculpture gallery and publishing house at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, founded in 2021, focused on sculptural mediums such as clay and ceramics that have often been overlooked in contemporary African art.

listings.name: Bang K
listings.address: 2 York Road, Muizenberg, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Bang K is a modern Asian restaurant with a Thai influence on York Road in Muizenberg, serving dishes such as crispy Thai hake with roasted chilli and tamarind, with a hidden outdoor courtyard offering glimpses of the sea.

listings.name: Beleza
listings.address: Corner of Burnside and Kloof Nek Roads, Tamboerskloof, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Beleza is a Portuguese- and Italian-influenced restaurant and bar at the corner of Kloof Nek and Burnside Roads, known for its peri-peri chicken and a broad menu spanning seafood, meat, pasta and vegetarian dishes, with daily happy-hour specials.

listings.name: Bihari
listings.address: 7 Main Road, Newlands, Cape Town, 7700
listings.current_description: Bihari is a North Indian restaurant at the Southern Sun Newlands hotel, cooking tandoori chicken, kebabs and a well-known prawn korma in traditional tandoor ovens, alongside a wide range of vegetarian curries, open for lunch and dinner daily.

listings.name: Bistro31 Bar & Eatery
listings.address: 31 Brickfield Road, Salt River, Cape Town, 7925
listings.current_description: Bistro31 Bar & Eatery is the in-house restaurant and bar of the DoubleTree by Hilton Cape Town Upper Eastside hotel, serving breakfast, lunch and dinner with tapas, salads, burgers and steak alongside a full bar and cocktail menu.

listings.name: Blue Water Café
listings.address: Imhoff Farm, Kommetjie Road, Kommetjie, Cape Town, 7975
listings.current_description: Blue Water Café is a family-friendly restaurant at Imhoff Farm on a historic 1743 Cape Dutch farmstead, serving modern Cape-style food and wood-fired pizzas with vegan and gluten-free options, alongside views over Long Beach and the farm's vineyards.

listings.name: Botanica Jewellery
listings.address: 373-375 Albert Road, Woodstock, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Botanica Jewellery is a Cape Town studio creating handcrafted sterling silver and gold jewellery with a botanical theme inspired by local fauna and flora, including engagement rings and custom commissions, based at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock.

listings.name: Debonairs Pizza Cavalier Belhar
listings.address: Shop 14, Cavalier Shopping Centre, Modderdam Road, Belhar, Cape Town, 7493
listings.current_description: Debonairs Pizza Cavalier Belhar is a pizza and fast-food outlet in the Cavalier Shopping Centre, part of the national Debonairs Pizza chain, offering pizza and chicken alongside its Real Deal and Triple-Decker ranges for eat-in, collection and delivery.

listings.name: El Burro Taqueria
listings.address: 12 Kloof Nek Road, Corner of Kloof Nek and New Church Street, Tamboerskloof, Cape Town
listings.current_description: El Burro Taqueria is a Mexican taqueria on Kloof Nek Road serving individually plated tacos with beef, chicken, pork, fish and vegetarian fillings alongside quesadillas, fresh ceviche and hand-pressed tortillas, though it does not hold a liquor licence.

listings.name: Epping Industrial Suppliers
listings.address: 7 Hawkins Ave, Epping, Cape Town, 7460
listings.current_description: Epping Industrial Suppliers is a family-owned industrial supplier in Epping, founded in 1973 and now in its third generation, stocking cleaning chemicals, paper products, personal protective equipment and industrial consumables for the manufacturing, hospitality, cleaning and engineering sectors.

listings.name: Evertsdal Guest House
listings.address: 1 Gillian Street, Eversdal, Durbanville, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Evertsdal Guest House is a guest house in Eversdal, Durbanville, established in 2002, offering 27 four-star and 5 five-star rooms along with conference and wedding facilities on over an acre of grounds with swimming pools and braai facilities.

listings.name: Kirstenhof Bookshop
listings.address: 254 Main Road, Kirstenhof, Cape Town, 7945
listings.current_description: Kirstenhof Bookshop is a charity bookshop run by Help the Rural Child, selling second-hand and donated books from its Main Road premises in Kirstenhof, with proceeds supporting rural children's programmes run by the Goedgedacht Trust in the Swartland.

listings.name: Live Bait
listings.address: Kalk Bay Harbour, Kalk Bay, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Live Bait is a seafood restaurant built on the breakwater at Kalk Bay Harbour, open since 1999, serving sushi, calamari, line fish and seafood platters alongside other non-seafood options, with views over False Bay and the working harbour.

listings.name: Marina Pub and Bistro
listings.address: Shop 36, Eastlake Shopping Centre, Eastlake Drive, Marina Da Gama, Muizenberg, Cape Town, 7945
listings.current_description: Marina Pub and Bistro is a pub and bistro in Eastlake Shopping Centre, Marina Da Gama, serving pub-style meals such as burgers, ribs and pizza alongside a range of craft beers, and hosting regular events including quiz nights.

listings.name: Maru Korean Steakhouse
listings.address: 107 Bree Street, Cape Town, 8001
listings.current_description: Maru Korean Steakhouse is a Korean restaurant on Bree Street in the Cape Town CBD, serving Korean-style steak, fried chicken and other Korean dishes, with a daily Magic Hour food and drinks special from 4pm to 5:30pm.

listings.name: Medindi Manor
listings.address: 4 Thicket Road, Rosebank, Cape Town, 7700
listings.current_description: Medindi Manor is a boutique guesthouse in a Victorian home built in the late 1890s in Rosebank, offering luxury, superior and standard rooms around a tropical garden with an outdoor pool, and breakfast served daily on the veranda.

listings.name: Mzansi Restaurant
listings.address: 45 Harlem Avenue, Langa, Cape Town, 7455
listings.current_description: Mzansi Restaurant is a traditional South African and Xhosa-cuisine restaurant on Harlem Avenue in Langa, serving a buffet-style menu that includes bobotie, chakalaka and malva pudding, with a live marimba band and township dance performances for booked groups.

listings.name: Newlands Brewery
listings.address: 3 Main Road, Newlands, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Newlands Brewery is the oldest operating brewery in South Africa, with roots tracing back to 1658 on the banks of the Liesbeek River; its historic Malthouse, Oasthouse and Mariendahl Tower buildings were granted national heritage status in 1995.

listings.name: Ozone Clinic Cape Town
listings.address: 31 2nd Avenue, Harfield Village, Cape Town, 7708
listings.current_description: Ozone Clinic Cape Town is a wellness clinic in Harfield Village offering ozone therapy treatments, including a HOCATT (Hyperthermic Ozone and Carbonic Acid Transdermal Therapy) sauna pod session that combines a carbonic acid steam cycle with medical-grade ozone.

listings.name: Sapphire Corporate Solutions
listings.address: 6 Inyoni Street, Ndabeni, Cape Town, 7405
listings.current_description: Sapphire Corporate Solutions is a corporate clothing and promotional gifting company on Inyoni Street in Ndabeni, founded in 1975, offering in-house design, branded product sourcing and manufacturing, and warehousing, packaging and distribution logistics from a large on-site warehouse.

listings.name: Simon's Town Guest House
listings.address: 20 Bennett Close, Cairnside, Simon's Town, Cape Town, 7975
listings.current_description: Simon's Town Guest House is a five-suite guest house in Cairnside, Simon's Town, offering en-suite rooms with sea views, free WiFi and a five-minute walk to Glencairn Beach; check-in is from 14:00 and check-out by 10:00.

listings.name: Sparesboyz / Korean Boyz
listings.address: 118a Voortrekker Road, Salt River, 7925
listings.current_description: Sparesboyz / Korean Boyz is a new and used motor spares dealer in Salt River specialising in Korean vehicle brands such as Hyundai, Kia and Daewoo alongside a wider range of OEM and aftermarket used parts, and is RMI-approved.

listings.name: Specsavers Rondebosch
listings.address: Shop G23, Rondebosch Main & Fountain Centre, 93 Main Street, Rondebosch, Cape Town, 7700
listings.hours: Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, Sat 09:00-13:00, Sun and Public holidays Closed
listings.current_description: Specsavers is an optometry retailer offering eye examinations and screening for conditions such as glaucoma and cataracts alongside eyewear and hearing services at selected stores; this branch trades from Shop G23 in Rondebosch Main & Fountain Centre, Rondebosch.

listings.name: The Sports Concept Store
listings.address: Shop D03, Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village, 27 Somerset Road, De Waterkant, Cape Town
listings.current_description: The Sports Concept Store is a premium sportswear and running-shoe retailer in Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village, De Waterkant, open since 2013 and stocking brands including Hoka, On, Under Armour and Asics alongside Randolph Sunglasses and Gooroo yoga mats.

listings.name: Technoline Projects
listings.address: Unit 49/50, Viking Business Place, Thor Circle, Thornton, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Technoline Projects is an engineering design, project management and contracting firm based in Thornton, providing turnkey telecoms infrastructure and optical fibre solutions -- including installation work for major fibre network rollouts -- to the cellular and telecommunications industry.

listings.name: Thai World
listings.address: Corner 2nd Avenue and Surrey Road, Harfield Village, Cape Town, 7708
listings.current_description: Thai World is a Thai restaurant in Harfield Village serving red, yellow and green curries with a choice of chicken, beef, seafood, pork or vegetables, alongside rice and noodle dishes, satay and soups, with a changing daily special.

listings.name: The Dental People
listings.address: 1 Loxton Road, Centre Point Shopping Centre, Milnerton, Cape Town, 7441
listings.current_description: The Dental People is a dental practice in Centre Point Shopping Centre, Milnerton, offering general and emergency dentistry, implants, veneers, teeth whitening, crowns and bridges, positioned as an affordable cash practice that also accepts select medical aid plans.

listings.name: The Neighbourgood
listings.address: Level 1, Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village, 27 Somerset Rd, De Waterkant, Cape Town
listings.current_description: The Neighbourgood at Cape Quarter is a co-living and co-working space in De Waterkant offering furnished studio to two-bedroom apartments alongside a co-working office and rooftop pool, with access to Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village's shops and cafés.
